scope: 14 new bespoke Sweaters subcategory photographs with the shared atmosphere treatment. The existing parent Sweaters campaign image is retained. All 15 Sweaters pages use bespoke campaign hero imagery. Existing product photography and all other page content outside the campaign note are unchanged.
artDirection: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one bespoke wide photographic hero for the WOW Fashion women's Sweaters collection, matching a premium warm editorial fashion campaign. Create ONE finished photograph, horizontal 16:9 landscape, ideally 1672 by 941 pixels. Authentic natural photography, lifelike skin, realistic tactile knit texture, anatomically correct hands and believable garment construction. One adult woman on the RIGHT side, centred near 77 percent of the image width. Frame from comfortably above her entire head down to at least just below her knees, showing the complete sweater neckline, sleeves, silhouette and hem. The knitwear is the clear focus; no coat, scarf, bag or crossed arms covering it. The LEFT 55 percent is quiet low-contrast warm pale limestone or plaster, unobstructed for dark website headlines. Architecture and foliage stay mostly at the far right. Soft flattering daylight, warm cream and pale stone surroundings, natural unforced posture and realistic fabric weight. No text, typography, logos, watermarks, UI, graphic gradients, smoke or artificial fog. The website adds its animated bottom blend later. An original fashion campaign in a real setting. Specific garment and scene:

assets.subject: An adult Black woman with soft natural shoulder-length curls wearing a warm oatmeal cardigan sweater with a clear open button front, ribbed placket, small tonal buttons, long sleeves and a neat hip-length hem. The cardigan is worn partly open over a simple ivory vest with dark straight jeans; hands relaxed at her sides leave the knit and opening fully visible. A pale limestone café courtyard in gentle morning light, detailed soft yarn and relaxed everyday styling.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in an oatmeal cardigan sweater in a pale limestone café courtyard

assets.subject: An adult East Asian woman in her thirties with a softly waved dark bob wearing a refined pale taupe cashmere-look crewneck sweater with a fine, softly brushed knit, delicate ribbed cuffs and a smooth relaxed hip-length hem. Quiet luxury styling with ivory tailored trousers, the sweater untucked so its full shape shows. She stands beside a pale travertine townhouse doorway in diffuse warm daylight; realistic delicate yarn texture with no large cables or pattern.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a pale taupe fine-knit sweater beside a travertine doorway

assets.subject: An adult South Asian woman with dark hair loosely tied back wearing a fresh powder-blue cotton-look sweater in a clean fine ribbed knit, an easy crewneck, long sleeves and a simple hip-length hem. A matte light knit with clear stitch definition and no fuzzy wool halo, styled with relaxed cream trousers. She stands beside a pale plaster garden wall in bright soft daylight, hands loosely at her sides and the whole sweater visible.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a powder-blue ribbed sweater beside a pale plaster garden wall

assets.subject: An adult woman with olive skin and loose chestnut waves wearing a dusty-rose cropped crewneck sweater with a clearly short straight ribbed hem ending at the natural waist, softly rounded long sleeves and textured knit stitches. High-waisted cream wide-leg trousers meet the sweater hem, modest everyday styling. She stands in a pale limestone courtyard, angled gently toward the camera so the short waist-length proportion is unmistakable, no front tuck and no long hem.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a dusty-rose cropped sweater with high-waisted cream trousers
